differences.title: 1. ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch is built in Rust, offering a single, self-contained binary for easy deployment and excellent performance with a focus on simplicity.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense uses a C++ core for speed, designed from the ground up for distributed deployments with fault tolerance and horizontal scalability.

differences.title: 2. DATA STRUCTURES
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch utilizes a prefix trie (radix tree) for highly efficient prefix matching and autocomplete suggestions, optimizing for keyboard-driven searches.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense also employs prefix tries for fast prefix search and typo tolerance, ensuring quick results as users type their queries.

differences.title: 3. TYPO TOLERANCE
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch implements typo tolerance using Levenshtein distance, allowing fuzzy matching for common typographical errors without significant performance impact.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense natively supports typo tolerance through Levenshtein distance, providing a seamless experience for users who make spelling mistakes.

differences.title: 4. SCALABILITY
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch primarily scales vertically by adding more resources to a single instance, making it ideal for smaller to medium-sized applications.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense is built for horizontal scaling, supporting sharding and replication across multiple nodes for high availability and massive datasets.

differences.title: 5. CONFIGURATION
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch prioritizes ease of use with sensible defaults and a straightforward configuration, reducing setup time and complexity for developers.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense offers a more tunable configuration, allowing fine-grained control over indexing and search parameters for specific performance needs.

differences.title: 6. FACETING
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch offers basic faceting capabilities to filter search results by categories or attributes, aiding in narrowing down search results.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense provides more advanced and efficient faceting, including multi-faceted search and custom sorting of facet values.

differences.title: 7. COMMUNITY & ECOSYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Meilisearch has a vibrant and growing community, with increasing adoption and contributions to its open-source project.
differences.rightDesc: Typesense focuses on a developer-first experience with excellent documentation and SDKs, fostering a strong community around its usability.
